{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the premises
print("Premise 1: 'converted' is 1 if the order completed checkout")
print(f"'converted' values: {sorted(sales['converted'].unique())}")
print(f"'converted' == 1 count: {sales['converted'].sum()}")

# Check for the presence of 'completed' status for converted orders
print("\nPremise 2: Are converted orders all 'completed'? (should be true)")
converted_status = sales[sales['converted'] == 1]['status']
print(f"Status of converted orders: {sorted(converted_status.unique())}")

# Check if any converted orders are refunded
refunded_converted = sales[(sales['converted'] == 1) & (sales['status'] == 'refunded')]
print(f"Number of converted orders with status 'refunded': {len(refunded_converted)}")

# Check the distribution of customer_age
print("\nDistribution of customer_age:")
print(sales['customer_age'].value_counts().sort_index())

# Note: -1 is sentinel for missing age
print(f"Number of -1 values in customer_age: {len(sales[sales['customer_age'] == -1])}")"}
